conflicts.description: The conflicts their live roles hold.

dormant.description: true when they have not signed in for 30 days, counting from when they joined if never (FR-CTL-06).

expired_roles.description: Roles that ended at their end date and that nobody ended: they grant nothing. A member who holds only these is an external user past their expiry, still a member (C.2 #6): remove them, or give a new end date.

external.description: true when a role they hold, or held until it expired, has an end date: an external user, reviewed each quarter (SEC-06).

last_sign_in.description: Their latest sign-in, by any of their identities; absent if they never signed in.

past_expiry.description: true for an external user whose roles have all ended while they are still a member (C.2 #6).

roles.description: Their live roles, by role, with an external user's end date.

second_factor.description: How their latest session passed its second factor: passkey, a passkey; sign_in, at the sign-in provider (an authenticator app); none, not yet, or never signed in.
